annotations.text:
A · Paper
Warm off-white, italic serif numerals, sage green. Calm training-journal feel. Trade-off: least 'sporty'; serif numbers are less scannable mid-run.

B · Track
Cool light grey, Space Grotesk everywhere, electric blue. Data-first and crisp; closest to a Garmin/Strava sensibility without copying either. Trade-off: most conventional.

C · Dusk
Still dark, but soft navy instead of black and mint instead of orange. Easiest on the eyes at night, charts pop. Trade-off: dark again — if the theme itself is the problem, skip.

D · Signal
Pure white, rounded Outfit type, coral as the one loud colour. Friendly and motivating; most 'consumer app'. Trade-off: coral is in the orange family; the large radii can feel toy-like with dense data.

Round 2 — light only. Same layout and type as B; only the palette changes.
Stay clear of orange/red so the accent never collides with HR zones or 'too hard' warnings.

E · Forest
Warm stone background, deep green accent. Outdoorsy, calm, reads 'trail'. Green also means 'on target' — accent and success share a hue, which can blur.

F · Plum
Cool white, violet accent. Distinctive — no running app uses it — and fully clear of zone colours. Trade-off: least 'athletic'.

G · Ink
No accent colour at all: black buttons, grey chrome. Colour appears only in data (zones, verdicts, session types), so it always means something. Most editorial; risks feeling austere.

H · Ocean
Warm white, deep teal. Between Forest and Track: sporty but not corporate blue, distinct from the green used for 'on target'. Safest all-rounder.
Round 3 — warm, Apple Health × Oura. New layout: no borders, soft shadows, gradient hero with a form ring, big coloured numbers (each metric owns a colour), floating pill tab bar.

I · Glow
Cream base, peach→rose hero, Figtree. Warmest and friendliest; closest to Apple Fitness. Trade-off: the peach is a cousin of orange.

J · Clay
Sand base, ochre→sage hero, dark text on the gradient, Albert Sans. Earthy and calm, more 'trail journal'. Trade-off: lowest contrast of the three; needs care with small text.

K · Bloom
Warm white, lavender→rose hero, plum text, Outfit. The Oura one: soft, premium, nothing orange about it. Trade-off: least obviously 'running'.
Round 4 — same layout as round 3, more masculine: deeper cooler hero gradients, heavier numerals (800 weight), stone/grey bases, greeting replaced by the day.

L · Slate
Stone base, navy→teal hero, Manrope 800. Nautical, solid; teal and amber numbers. The balanced one.

M · Moss
Warm grey base, forest→moss hero, Sora 800. Outdoors, trail, Mafra hills. Ochre numbers keep it warm.

N · Graphite
Near-monochrome: charcoal hero with one amber ring. The most serious; colour only where it earns it. Risk: a touch austere.
